json.coverage_note: Texas courts of appeals opinions (1st-14th, plus the statewide Fifteenth since 2024) are filed almost all under ONE id, texapp (487,528 opinions, 1876-2025), whatever the court. The per-court ids txctapp1..txctapp14 hold only a separate CourtListener import (5,319 opinions in all; txctapp14: 81 opinions (2002-2023)), so a filter on one of them misses almost every opinion of that court. Use court="texapp,txctapp14" and read the court from the citation parenthetical ("Tex. App.-Houston [14th Dist.]"). The Court of Criminal Appeals is texcrimapp. Read as the 14th Court of Appeals (Houston).
json.tip: Use the id value as the court parameter of search_cases. A trailing * matches prefixes: court="fla*" covers all Florida courts. Common ids: scotus, ca1..ca11, cadc, fla (FL Supreme), fladistctapp1..6 (FL DCAs), ga, gactapp.
